description: A targeted delivery rollout of 0.12345 puts the threshold at 1234.5. Allocation bucket 1234 is below it, so the rule serves its variation. A port that never applies the allocation to targeted delivery passes this case; a port that floors the threshold to 1234 fails it.

probe.why: Half a bucket below a fractional targeted delivery threshold: inside under the float comparison, outside under a floored one.
